issues.description: The template sets number_of_bits_classical_register to a string ("0") which will cause a type error when constructing ClassicalRegister and conflicts with the problem description and solution that expect an integer number of classical bits. This is likely an unintentional type error in the template that will block students from instantiating the circuit correctly.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template's self.number_of_bits_classical_register from the string "0" to an integer (e.g. 0) or another appropriate integer default. Ensure the ClassicalRegister is constructed using an int so students can replace it with the intended number of classical bits.
